prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. report.answer: Stripped leading and trailing whitespace in `markdown.extensions.toc.slugify` after removing non-word characters so headings with trailing punctuation do not produce a trailing separator in their generated ID, and added a regression test.
